steps.name: Run stratified benchmark
steps.run:
LIMIT="${{ github.event.inputs.limit || '100' }}"
SEED="${{ github.event.inputs.seed || '42' }}"
if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.random_sample }}" ]; then
  python scripts/run_benchmark_loop.py \
    --random-sample "${{ github.event.inputs.random_sample }}" \
    --seed "$SEED" \
    --validate
else
  python scripts/run_benchmark_loop.py \
    --corpus popular-100 \
    --limit "$LIMIT" \
    --seed "$SEED" \
    --validate
fi

steps.name: Commit updated exports/latest artifacts
steps.run:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add exports/latest/
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "chore(benchmark): update exports/latest telemetry"
  git pull --rebase --autostash origin "${{ github.ref_name }}"
  git push origin "HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}"
fi

pipelines.name: Daily Target Repo Exports & Portal Refresh

steps.name: Run daily exports (discovery, pipelines, code AST, OSV, SBOM, SARIF, drift, org summary)
steps.run:
mkdir -p .cache
args=(
  benchmark
  --corpus-file "$CORPUS_FILE"
  --merge-latest
  --isolated
  --no-resume
  --timeout "$TIMEOUT_VAL"
  --max-concurrent "$MAX_CONCURRENT_VAL"
  --osv-cache-path .cache/osv_cache.json
)
if [ -n "$LIMIT_VAL" ]; then
  args+=(--limit "$LIMIT_VAL")
fi
if [ "$LIVE_OSV_VAL" = "true" ]; then
  args+=(--live-osv)
else
  args+=(--no-live-osv)
fi
if [ "$DIFF_PREV_VAL" = "true" ]; then
  args+=(--diff-previous)
else
  args+=(--no-diff-previous)
fi
atruss "${args[@]}"

steps.name: Smoke-test Astro portal & exports schema before committing
Commit and push updated exports/latest telemetry
steps.run:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add -A exports/latest/
if git diff --cached --quiet || ! python scripts/has_semantic_export_changes.py; then
  git reset -q HEAD -- exports/latest/
  git checkout -- exports/latest/ || true
  git clean -fd -- exports/latest/
  echo "committed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No semantic changes in exports/latest/ to commit."
else
  git commit -m "chore(daily-export): refresh exports/latest snapshot"
  pushed=false
  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    git pull --rebase --autostash origin "${{ github.ref_name }}"
    if git push origin "HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}"; then
      pushed=true
      break
    fi
    sleep 3
  done
  if [ "$pushed" != "true" ]; then
    echo "::error::Failed to push exports/latest snapshot after 3 attempts."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "committed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi
